caption:
Your tap water's hardness has no legal limit 💧
There are no UK standards for water hardness. Severn Trent measures it as calcium carbonate: up to 50 mg/l is soft, over 300 mg/l is very hard. It isn't harmful, not even very hard water, but it shouldn't normally go above 500 mg/l, because some people can taste the minerals and pipes scale up.
